name: Bid-Ask — volatile
description: More liquidity toward the outer bins, for volatile pairs.
placeholderNote: Placeholder. Bid-Ask-for-volatile-markets is the public guide's use case. The 61-bin width and the 12% / bin-step-80 trigger are untuned.
notes: Docs: Bid-Ask is an inverse Curve, with more liquidity near the edges. It is aimed at volatile markets and at catching movement away from the current price. Larger bin steps suit faster markets. The base fee scales with bin step; the variable fee rises with the volatility accumulator and is capped at 10%. Live deposits use StrategyType.BidAsk.
